results.name: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (EZ-Bar)
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight an EZ bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the EZ bar with both hands using an underhand grip (palms facing up), hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and elbows close to your body. Your forearms should be parallel to the floor.
Push the EZ bar down towards your thighs by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, allowing your forearms to become parallel to the floor again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid moving your upper arms.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you push the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (EZ-Bar) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Triceps Overhead Extension (EZ Bar)
instructions: Attach an EZ bar to the high pulley of a cable machine. Stand with your back facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the EZ bar with both hands, palms facing up.
Step forward slightly to create tension in the cable and position your feet in a staggered stance for stability. Extend your arms straight up above your head, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Lower the EZ bar behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower the EZ bar.
Keep your elbows close to your ears and stationary throughout the exercise.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
results.description: Cable Triceps Overhead Extension (EZ Bar) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Triceps Push Down Elbow Out (V Bar)
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight, knees slightly bent and lean slightly forward.

Grasp the V-bar attached to the high pulley with both hands, palms facing each other, and place your hands shoulder-width apart. Bend your elbows at a 90-degree angle, with your elbows flared out to the sides.
Push the V-bar down towards your thighs by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms close to your torso.
Slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and avoid injury of your elbow joints.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you push the V-bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Triceps Push Down Elbow Out (V Bar) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Chair Triceps Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with your hands placed next to your hips, gripping the edge of the chair.
Extend your legs out in front of you with your heels on the floor and your legs straight.
Slide your hips off the chair and lower your body by bending your elbows until they form a 90-degree angle.
Push through your palms to extend your elbows and lift your body back up to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back close to the chair to maintain proper form and avoid straining your shoulders.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to keep tension on your triceps.
Ensure your shoulders remain down and away from your ears to avoid unnecessary strain.
results.description: Chair Triceps Dips is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.
